user.title: Bambu Printer Webhook
user.description: Every Bambu Lab printer set up through the Bambu Lab integration sends its state to this webhook. A test message is sent first to check the address and token.

data_description.webhook_url: Where the printer state is sent, as a POST with a JSON body.
data_description.token: Sent along as a bearer token in the Authorization header.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full http:// or https:// address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach this address. Check it, and that Home Assistant can reach the internet.
error.wrong_endpoint: This address does not take printer states. Check the full path, not just the domain.
error.unexpected_response: The webhook gave an unexpected answer to a test message. Check the address and the receiver's logs.

abort.already_configured: This webhook is already set up.

init.title: Bambu Printer Webhook
init.description:
A change in a printer's status, its print or the spools it holds is sent within half a minute. Everything else (progress, layers, a spool's percentage) is sent with the interval.

For what a print cost in electricity: pick the energy meter (kWh) of each printer's plug, and the electricity price, either a sensor with your tariff or a fixed price. Without a sensor or when it has no value, the fixed price is used.

data_description.interval: How often the state is sent regardless of changes, in seconds.
data_description.price_entity: A sensor with the all-in price per kWh (taxes included), for a dynamic tariff: each kWh is paid at the price of the moment it was used. In cents per kWh is converted.
data_description.price_per_kwh: Euros per kWh, used without a price sensor.
data_description.history_since: Once, the prints still on each printer's storage are sent to the site, from this day on. Anything printed earlier is left out; empty means everything. Changing it has no effect once the import has run.
